paper_summary.text: On AgentDojo (important\_instructions attack, 28 logged model/defence pipelines, 22 models), RiskGate calibrated per pipeline at $\alpha=5\%$ keeps the re-split mean unsafe-certified rate at 2.0\% (median over 27 held-out pipelines, range 0.2--3.1\%) against a median base rate of 29.3\%, asks about a median 44\% of state-changing calls (median AUROC 0.88) and cuts the median attack success rate from 12.3\% to 1.5\%.
